QuestInfo.name: Rumor about the Dragon Mount
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1032001##k in #m101000000# starts to talk to you...
QuestInfo.1: #p1032001# says that he has heard a rumor about a #bDragon mount#k and is curious whether an Onyx Dragon can be mounted. If it seems possible after talking to #b#p1013000##k, return to #p1032001#.\r\n\r\n#y22401# #b(#u22401#)#k
QuestInfo.2: #p1032001# says that he heard about a very powerful warrior named #p9901000# who knows how to mount a dragon and suggests that you go to #m102000000# and meet with #p9901000#.

0.0: How is your research on Onyx Dragons going? I recently heard an interesting rumor about a #bDragon mount#k. Someone was seen in Victoria Island riding a Dragon.
0.1: Amazing, right? Dragons are known to be haughty and prideful, but I guess they let humans they are close to ride them. I wonder if the same applies to Onyx Dragons.
0.2: But we can't study Onyx Dragons, since they became extinct a long time ago... I wish there were #bsomeone we could talk to who'd know about whether Onyx Dragons can be used as mounts#k.
0.3: I thought I'd tell you about it, since you're researching Onyx Dragons. If you ever find out whether Onyx Dragons can be mounted, do come back to #b#m101000000##k and let me know.

no.0: Hmm... I guess your research hasn't reached that level yet.

1.0: Oh, it's you... How is your study of Onyx Dragons going? Did you ever find out if Onyx Dragons can be mounted. \r\n#L0##bI think it is possible, but I'm not sure how. I should ask the person who is rumored to have ridden a Dragon.#l\n#k
1.1: Hm. I guess the person I mentioned before who was riding a Dragon wasn't riding an Onyx Dragon. Still, maybe you'd learn how to mount an Onyx Dragon if you talk to him about how he mounts his own Dragon.

yes.0: If you are really interested, you should visit #m102000000#. #b#p9901000##k is said to be at the #b#m102000000 Warrior's Sanctuary#. You should be able to find out more about mounting Dragons from him. He is supposed to be very powerful...
yes.1: I guess if an Onyx Dragon had a close enough relationship with a human, then the Dragon would let that human mount him. This will take some more studying...

quest.0: It would be nice if we could just ask an Onyx Dragon about this...
